items.raw_excerpt: Trasloca il villaggio per i clochard in nome di Giovanni Tamburi, 16enne vittima di Crans-Montana, dopo le proteste dei cittadini del quartiere inizialmente scelto per la sua realizzazione a Bologna. Il villaggio per i senzatetto – che il ragazzo da giovane aiutava di nascosto – si farà. Non al Lazzaretto però, dopo che i cittadini […]
items.summary_en: A village for homeless people in Bologna, built in memory of teenager Giovanni Tamburi who secretly helped the homeless, will be relocated. Citizens protested the original Lazzaretto location. The project will go ahead in a different part of the city.
items.summary_ko: 볼로냐에서 16세 소년 제반니 타무르기를 추모하며 건립되는 노숙자 지원 마을이 원래 부지인 라자레또 대신 다른 장소로 이전된다. 시민들의 반발로 계획이 변경되었지만, 프로젝트는 계속 추진될 예정이다.
items.title_en: Homeless village in memory of Giovanni Tamburi will not be at Lazzaretto

items.raw_excerpt: Nesses cinco anos de sede nova, o Museu produziu mais de 1 mil espetáculos e oficinas, e o público chegou a mais de 400 mil visitantes.
items.summary_en: In five years at its new home, the museum put on more than 1,000 shows and workshops. Its visitors passed 400,000. The museum celebrates 50 years of Brazilian popular art.

items.raw_excerpt: "Confidently Wrong" explores urgent healthcare in Mexico through a co-host's real heart surgery story — costs, care and lessons learned.
items.summary_en: A podcast called 'Confidently Wrong' shares a co-host's real heart surgery story in Mexico. It explores the costs, quality of care, and lessons learned about the Mexican healthcare system. The story highlights both the strengths and challenges of seeking medical treatment in Mexico.

items.raw_excerpt: No injuries were reported and the cause of the fire is under investigation.
items.summary_en: A fire burned through about three hectares of greenery near Seletar Link in Singapore. Firefighters put out the blaze. No one was hurt and the cause is being looked into.
